critical_code_review_comments: scorer_bundles.py:80 — _extract_player regex requires the player name to START with a capital ASCII letter ([A-Z][A-Za-zÀ-ÿ.\-' ]+). Lowercase or non-Latin starts (e.g. 'éderson Anytime Goal Scorer') would fail extraction and fall back to elite_player_name. Worked fine for 'Cody Gakpo' on today's slate.

scorer_bundles.py:114 — Bail condition uses p_anytime >= 0.95 (huge favorite). For ultra-long-shot anytime scorers (p < 0.01, e.g. +9999), the math still runs and produces near-zero probabilities — these emit Hat Trick around 0.0001 floor, which is fine but the synthesized output is mostly noise. Consider a symmetric lower bound (e.g. p_anytime <= 0.02).

sportsdataio_client.py:201 — When find_injury returns None, code sets profile['injury_status']=profile.get('injury_status') or 'healthy'. Verified on Soto (injury_status='healthy'). Good defensive default.

sportsdataio_client.py:159-206 — enrich_profile guards Soccer/Tennis (returned untouched) and only enriches NBA/NFL/MLB. Wrapped in try/except so a SportsDataIO outage won't break the refresh job — verified by the clean idempotent refresh.

routes.py:48-51 — Profile merge logic: DB learned data overwrites seed EXCEPT 'archetype' when archetype_source=='seed'.
